name: SysBench-ISR
intro: SysBench-ISR 不是独立数据集，而是 GLM-4.5 报告对原始 SysBench 的指令满足率（ISR）指标切片。它复用 SysBench 的500个会话、2500轮对话及逐指令约束检查表；只有一条回复同时满足该指令的全部约束时，该指令才计为满足。
org: Z.ai, Tsinghua University; SysBench by Peking University and Baichuan AI
build_method: 复用SysBench：在线日志筛选、21名标注者、GPT-4o辅助五轮对话、逐指令约束检查表、多专家复核
eval_feature: SysBench指标切片, 全约束同时满足, LLM验证器
build_method_en: Reuses SysBench: online-log filtering, 21 annotators, GPT-4o-assisted five-turn dialogues, per-instruction constraint checklists, and multi-expert review
eval_feature_en: SysBench metric slice, all-constraints satisfaction, LLM verifier
intro_en: SysBench-ISR is not a separate dataset; it is the Instruction Satisfaction Rate slice of the original SysBench used in the GLM-4.5 report. It reuses SysBench's 500 sessions, 2,500 turns, and per-instruction constraint checklists. An instruction counts only when every associated constraint is satisfied.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with GLM-4.5 arXiv:2508.06471 Sections 3.3 and 4.2.4, including Figure 9; SysBench arXiv:2408.10943 Section 3 and Appendix A; official PKU-Baichuan-MLSystemLab/SysBench repository. SysBench-ISR is not a separate benchmark dataset. The GLM-4.5 report uses the Instruction Satisfaction Rate slice of the original SysBench for instruction-following evaluation and shows it as the SysBench-ISR training curve. The underlying SysBench defines six atomic constraint types, cleans thousands of online system messages with heuristics and clustering, and has twenty-one trained annotators select 500 system messages. GPT-4o assists five-round conversation generation; annotators rewrite the conversations, label aligned and misaligned instructions plus parallel and dependent sessions, and write a constraint checklist for every instruction. Multi-expert review freezes 500 sessions and 2,500 turns. During evaluation, the target model receives the system message, dialogue history, and current instruction. An advanced-LLM verifier uses the same context plus the checklist to judge every relevant constraint as satisfied or not. ISR counts an instruction only when all associated constraints are satisfied, then averages this binary result over instructions. GLM-4.5 reports this metric slice rather than a new SysBench-ISR dataset.
